manifest.configuration_1: Allow browser microphone access for live capture; optionally configure an iCalendar path or URL, the local task ledger, agent roles, and speech-correction terms in Settings.
manifest.description: An AI meeting assistant. Transcribes a live meeting, keeps structured notes and diagrams as it goes, extracts action items, and lets you review them before filing.
manifest.highlight_1: Live transcription through Kiro Crew's own speech-to-text — no extra daemon, no cloud account beyond what you already use
manifest.highlight_2: A crew of agents works the meeting in parallel: structured notes, an HTML/Mermaid diagram, and an action-item list
manifest.highlight_3: Correct recurring speech-to-text mistakes once with a domain dictionary and every later meeting gets them right
manifest.highlight_4: Review extracted action items before anything is filed — archive the noise, file the rest
manifest.highlight_5: Pluggable task and calendar providers: ships a local task ledger and an iCalendar (.ics) reader, and an organization can register its own
manifest.highlight_6: Read the transcript back line by line in another language while the meeting runs
manifest.highlight_7: Keep your own notes beside the agents' — paste a screenshot and it lands with the meeting's elapsed time
manifest.use_case_1: Capture a live meeting while parallel agents build the transcript, structured notes, diagram, and action-item review.
